text: Open-source super AI assistant & Agent Harness. Plans tasks, runs tools and skills, autonomously grows with memory and knowledge. Multi-model, multi-channel, multi-agent. Lightweight, extensible, one-line install — runs 24/7 on your laptop or server. One command to install, configure, and launch — for developers and 24/7 servers # Install and run CowAgent $ bash <(curl -fsSL https://cdn.link-ai.tech/code/cow/run.sh) # Install and run CowAgent (PowerShell) > irm https://cdn.link-ai.tech/code/cow/run.ps1 | iex # Install and run CowAgent (Docker) $ curl -O https://cdn.link-ai.tech/code/cow/docker-compose.yml $ docker compose up -d Core Capabilities Not just chat — an AI assistant that actually gets things done Decomposes complex tasks and executes them step by step, looping over tools and skills until the goal is reached. Three-tier architecture (context → daily → core) with automatic Deep Dream distillation and hybrid keyword + vector retrieval. Auto-curates structured knowledge into a Markdown wiki, building an evolving knowledge graph through cross-references. One-click install from Skill Hub, GitHub, and ClawHub, or create custom Skills through natural-language conversation. Built-in file I/O, terminal, browser, scheduler, memory retrieval, web search, and 10+ more tools — with native MCP integration. Reviews conversations automatically to improve skills, follow up on unfinished tasks, and consolidate memory and knowledge. Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Doubao, and more — swap providers with one click. A single Agent integrates with Web, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, and Official Accounts. Create multiple Agents with distinct roles to form a team, with group-chat collaboration, task delegation, and sub-Agents — quickly build your own team of digital employees. Plug in any major LLM and deploy across multiple channels
